author: 893aleixb

title: Great experience
text: I took a sailing lesson at Business Yacht Club Barcelona and it was an excellent experience. The instructor was very professional, patient and passionate about sailing, which made learning enjoyable and motivating. The class was practical from the start, with clear explanations about both maneuvers and safety on board. The sailboat was in perfect condition and the surroundings of the port and coast of Barcelona made everything even more special. I learned a lot in a few hours and felt more confident at the helm. Ideal for those who want to start sailing or improve their skills. Highly recommen
